description: This file provides seed data functions for initializing the application state with sample habits and tasks, including utility functions to generate these data structures with realistic properties for a habit and task tracking React application.

methods.name: makeHabit
methods.description: Creates a habit object with a unique ID, name, description, color, completion dates based on a range, and streak stats.

methods.name: makeTask
methods.description: Creates a task object with a unique ID, title, description, status, priority, due date, tags, and optional completion date.
